concerns.text: Task T001 is tagged with [FR-001] but only downloads and verifies datasets; it does not implement the sparsity knob required by FR-001, constituting a weakening of the functional requirement.

The verification step for T009 states that the attribution script runs only on the hold‑out set defined in plan.md, yet the plan does not define any hold‑out set. This makes the verification unimplementable and risks dropping the acceptance criteria for FR‑005.
